name: Orbit AI - CRM Architecture - Billing Period rollover (05 Section 15, new - not brief-W-numbered)

nodes.name: Every day at 4am
nodes.notes: 05 Section 15: BillingPeriod is 'auto-generated monthly for both M2M and Term contracts.' W1.6 creates period #1 on Won; contract-amendment-flow.workflow.json closes/reopens a period on an Amendment. This workflow is the third leg - the STEADY-STATE case, where a Contract just keeps running unchanged and its current period simply ends. Runs after nightly-backup.workflow.json's 3am slot, same 'confirm the instance's configured timezone' caveat that workflow already flags.

nodes.name: Fetch active Contracts
nodes.notes: A Superseded Contract is skipped by construction (this filter) - its final period was already closed by contract-amendment-flow.workflow.json when it got superseded, so it has nothing left to roll over.

nodes.name: Split Contracts
nodes.notes: Splits the Contracts list response into one item per Contract ID for the per-Contract Billing Period check below. ASSUMES the list response is a plain array with a top-level 'id' field per row - same REST-shape uncertainty as every workflow here; adjust the split field once the real response shape is confirmed.

nodes.name: Fetch Contract's Billing Periods
nodes.notes: Same per-Contract fetch-then-decide shape as contract-amendment-flow.workflow.json's own Billing Period handling - deliberately not deduplicated into a shared sub-workflow this pass, since the two callers want different things (amendment always closes+reopens; this one only reopens when the current period has actually ended).

nodes.name: Create next Billing Period

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contractId: $json.contractId, periodStart: $json.nextPeriodStart, periodEnd: new Date(new Date($json.nextPeriodStart).getTime() + 30*24*60*60*1000).toISOString(), revenueCents: 0, commissionStatus: 'accrued' }) }}

nodes.notes: periodStart picks up exactly where the previous period's periodEnd left off (no gap, no overlap) rather than 'now' - if this job is ever late (instance down overnight, say), the new period still starts on schedule instead of drifting. revenueCents starts at 0, same flagged simplification as W1.6/the amendment workflow: real revenue linkage needs a recurring-charge Stripe webhook this repo doesn't wire up yet (only the initial Checkout Session is handled). periodEnd is a naive +30 days, not calendar-month-aware, matching the existing simplification already flagged in W1.6 rather than introducing a second, inconsistent date convention.
